queries.name: wms-part-number
queries.description: Returns WMS inventory by part number with optional location filters.
queries.sql: SELECT wms.part_number AS part_number, wms.part_name AS part_name, wms.origin AS origin, wms.destination AS destination, wms.qtd_saldo AS qtd_saldo, wms.subinventario AS subinventario, wms.enderecofrom AS enderecofrom, wms.nrolpn AS nrolpn, wms.setcode AS setcode FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(cod_part_number, 1, INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') - 1) ELSE cod_part_number END AS part_number, dsc_part_name AS part_name, CASE WHEN INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(cod_part_number, INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') + 1, INSTR(cod_part_number, '-', -1) - INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') - 1) END AS origin, CASE WHEN INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(cod_part_number, INSTR(cod_part_number, '-', -1) + 1) END AS destination, qtd_item_lpn AS qtd_saldo, cod_sub_inv AS subinventario, cod_endereco AS enderecofrom, cod_lpn_num AS nrolpn, cod_setcode AS setcode FROM bdwms_yma.ym_wms_vw_lpn_erp WHERE INSTR(cod_part_number, '-') > 0) wms WHERE wms.part_number = :part_number AND (:subinventario IS NULL OR wms.subinventario = :subinventario) AND (:setcode IS NULL OR wms.setcode = :setcode) AND (:enderecofrom IS NULL OR wms.enderecofrom LIKE :enderecofrom)
